verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs say you can assign a custom domain you own to your app. That implies the product hosts published apps at a live URL, but the pack never describes the publish action itself or shows it is a single step. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the publish-to-live-URL flow, evidence that publishing is one step, default hosted URL details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can publish my app to a live URL in one step

citations.quote: You can also assign a custom domain that you own.
